user_query: I'm a teacher planning a field trip for my students to a historical site. Can you recommend some educational activities and games to make the trip more engaging? Also, provide me with a list of nearby hotels with group rates.

TaskList.description: Research and suggest educational activities and games suitable for a field trip to a historical site.
Find nearby hotels that offer group rates for students and faculty.
Compile a detailed itinerary including suggested activities and hotel information.
